tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently purchased new furniture for your dorm room from an online store, and you are satisfied with it in general. However, you noticed some issues with the furniture. You need to contact customer service about the issue. Write an email to customer service.
bullets: Mention what you particularly liked about the furniture.
Describe the issue you noticed with the furniture.
Suggest a resolution for the problem.
tasks.subject: Recent Furniture Purchase Issue
